display_title: Be Careful of That Younger Man!
description:
"The kid I carried on my back and raised has grown up like this?"

"This is the last chance to catch my brother!"

Dohyeon, the scheming top who chose to retake the CSAT without hesitation despite getting top grades, and... "Oh my god, the kid next door I practically raised has grown up to be totally my type?"

A Risky Tutoring Scandal!
